result: Re-keyed MissionCanvasStore canonical persistence partitions to WorkstreamKey::storage_key rather than the flattened project/continuity/session authority context. Added MissionCanvasStore.load_projection/save_projection as the named core seam, retained get_projection/put_projection compatibility wrappers, validated exact Workstream ownership and projection/event revisions, scoped event cursors to the same partition, and quarantined pre-Workstream rows instead of guessing ownership. Added hostile persistence coverage for projection, layout memory, evidence, receipt, omission diagnostics, foreign scope, orphan surface authority, stale revisions/cursors, and ambiguous legacy rows.

omitted_contribution_reasons: Workstream-keyed persistence is a canonical core slice with no direct rendered contribution

negative_cases.foreign_workstream: Every canonical row uses the validated WorkstreamKey storage hash. save_projection and put_document reject a foreign event/data Workstream, while load_projection/events_after use only the requested Workstream partition.
negative_cases.missing_authority: canonical_scope_key requires MissionCanvasScope validation and rejects a WorkSurface without its exact Attachment authority. No project_root plus continuity_id fallback is accepted.
negative_cases.stale_revision_cursor: save_projection applies the existing optimistic revision gate before writing or appending its event; a stale writer leaves the projection and event stream unchanged. Event replay and latest_event_sequence are partitioned by Workstream, so another Workstream's cursor cannot be used.
negative_cases.unavailable_capability: Persistence preserves omission_diagnostics, including capability_not_present, and never promotes an unavailable contribution or invents a layout/action. Eligibility remains owned by the core resolver.
negative_cases.ineligible_or_empty_contribution: Projection, layout-memory, evidence, receipt, and omission diagnostic payloads round-trip without substituting empty content or resolving contribution eligibility in storage.
negative_cases.ambiguous_legacy_row: Migration identifies pre-Workstream scope keys as legacy evidence, retains their raw row payload in mission_canvas_legacy_quarantine, and never parses project/continuity/session values to assign a Workstream. Canonical reads cannot see quarantined rows.
negative_cases.projection_event_mismatch: save_projection rejects foreign Workstream event scopes and projection/event revision mismatches before opening a write transaction.
